breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory instruction in the preamble, stating to use dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1) for this task, which conflicts with the standard periodic grid definition and the specific instruction in section 7 (dx=1/Nx). The agent correctly ignored the contradictory preamble instruction and used the correct definition 'dx = 1.0 / Nx', which aligns with the ground truth prompt where the contradictory text was removed.
